title: Diagnose retrieval quality before adding more semantic decisions
steps: Check exact response fields and retained raw answers separately from semantic completeness.
Check coverage by requested facet and exact candidate span before interpreting selector quality.
Join native consumer usage with actual source-owner request/application receipts; do not infer actor binding from pane identity.
Report total/cached/uncached input, output including reasoning, wall time, known provider USD and unknown subscription USD separately.
Patch the retrieval structure or candidate enumerator for observed misses; keep original comparisons frozen.
stopWhen: Unknown paid outcome would be replayed or accounting storage would need unauthorized repair.
limitation: A reusable execution recipe; historical success does not certify a different source or current native environment.
